True concurrent OS-thread filesystem races remain UNVERIFIED (in-process inflight is host coordination, not an OS file lock). AC15.claim: Overlapping same-target typed writes are classified conflict. Two OS threads against ConflictCoordinator observe exactly one acquire and one conflict. Scoped-thread IPC dispatch of two overlapping write_note calls observes classified_as=conflict on the second writer and a single physical file from the first. Distinct-target sequential writes are disk_verified and are not recorded as same-target atomicity. Sequential dest-exists stays unsupported. This is host inflight coordination, not an OS file lock and not T03 forced-kill / atomic filesystem overwrite.
